tables.title: Compatibility of STM32 low power modes with the OTG
tables.text: Table 739, "Compatibility of STM32 low power modes with the OTG", in section 73.9 (OTG low-power modes) on page 3774. Columns: Mode, Description, USB compatibility. 4 data row(s). Notes: 1. Within Stop mode there are different possible settings. Some restrictions may also exist, refer to to understand which (if any) restrictions apply when using OTG.
